newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada May industrial price index flat from April.
newsitem.headline: Canada May industrial price index flat from April.

text.p: issued the following economic indicators for May.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
The IPPI reflects the prices producers receive as goods leave their plants.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 1.5 percent in May from April.
The unchanged month-over-month index in May shows there continued to be relatively little upward pressure on goods prices in the Canadian economy, Statistics Canada said.
The federal agency said that in May, the most important monthly declines were for motor vehicles (-1.0 percent) and softwood lumber (-1.7 percent).
The most important increases were for pulp (+3.5 percent) and pork (+4.0 percent), StatsCan said.
The agency said almost all of May's change in motor vehicle prices was due to the change in the value of the Canadian dollar.
